The '''Opoku system''', also known as the '''Gamorr system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Galov sector/Legends|Galov sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]].

It was used as a rendezvous point for the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]] while attempting to escape an [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] fleet.<ref name="Legacy (2006) 42">[[Legacy (2006) 42|''Legacy'' (2006) 42]]</ref>

The [[Prison/Legends|prison]] planet [[Drash-So]] was located near the system.<ref name="Legacy (2013) 15">[[Legacy (2013) 15|''Legacy'' (2013) 15]]</ref>
